messages:
harper: Heads-up: Kestrel (paying customer) reporting p99 embedding latency spike on Dedicated pool-3 starting ~07:12 UTC. Support ticket TIX-4921 opened. Need fast triage + short-term workaround. @alex @maria @ryan

alex: Looking now — can you confirm model + quant and typical batch sizes? Any recent config changes?

harper: Model=redwood-embed-v2-quant, batching=auto (max_batch=64). No deliberate config changes on our side; suspect cache miss storm after a cache eviction event.

maria: If it's cache misses, enabling prefix/KV sharing should help reduce p99. I can flip kv_sharing on pool-3 for a short window. Need an owner to approve rollback window.

ryan: I approve a 2h change window. Please post expected impact and rollback steps here. I'll monitor alerts.

alex: I'll add extra logging for cache hit/miss and tail-call latencies (PR 1248). If we see improvement after kv_sharing=true, we can make it a longer config or add a fallback to smaller batch sizes.

maria: Plan: 1) enable kv_sharing=true on pool-3 for 2h; 2) restart worker nodes one at a time to pick up runtime flag; 3) monitor p50/p90/p99 and support ticket. Rollback: set kv_sharing=false and restart. ETA ~10m to start.

harper: Sounds good. Action items: maria -> flip kv_sharing (2h), alex -> PR 1248 to add logs + metric, ryan -> monitor & update TIX-4921, harper -> notify customer.

maria: Running commands now:
```bash
# enable KV sharing for pool-3 for 2 hours
redwoodctl pools update pool-3 --set kv_sharing=true --set kv_sharing_duration=2h
# rolling restart to pick up flag (one node at a time)
redwoodctl pools restart pool-3 --rolling --reason "Kestrel p99 spike mitigation"
```

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-18T07:25:30Z started: rolling restart pool-3 (initiated by maria)

oncall-bot: alert suppression applied for TIX-4921 for 120 minutes by ryan

alex: Saw initial logs — cache miss rate dropping after first node restart, p99 moved from ~1.8s to ~0.9s on partial pool. Will report full numbers after restart completes.

harper: Great. Maria, please post exact commands used in the ticket (TIX-4921) for audit. Also log the time window + roll-forward decision criteria.

maria: Added command snippet and checklist to TIX-4921. If p99 improves <1.0s and error rates stable after 2h, propose leaving kv_sharing=true and schedule follow-up to evaluate long-term config.

ryan: Monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood/s/graphs?panel=kestrel-pool3-embed . I'll update ticket every 15m.

harper: Thanks team. Quick ask: alex, can you get PR 1248 merged ASAP (small logging + metrics) so we have better visibility if this recurs?

alex: Yep — pushing small change, requesting review from @mike. Target merge in next 30m.

harper: If anything regresses or we need to revert, ping this thread and @eng-oncall.

support-bot: TIX-4921 updated: customer notified of mitigation steps; expected improvement ETA 30 minutes.

maria: Rolling restart finished. Full pool p99 now ~0.88s, p90 ~0.12s. Leaving kv_sharing=true for now per plan.

ryan: No new alerts. I'll keep suppression until 09:25 UTC and then remove if stable.

harper: Closing loop: action owners confirmed. Follow-up: schedule postmortem if we see recurrence (assign to alex + maria). :thumbsup:
